Fulfilled by Screwfix: your range, powered by the Screwfix network

Fulfilled by Screwfix (FBS) lets you plug your stock into the scale, speed and reach of the Screwfix logistics network. You keep ownership of your inventory until it sells. We store it and get it to Trade customers through our stores, distribution centres and fulfilment centres, with the same service standards they already trust us for.

Why partners choose FBS

  • Reach more Trade customers: get your range in front of millions of active, repeat Trade customers.
  • Unlock store collection: connect your inventory with our nationwide store network and Collect from Screwfix.
  • Speed and scale: benefit from the consolidation and efficiency of Screwfix fulfilment, without having to build it yourself.
  • Stay in control: with consignment, stock remains yours until the point of sale, and you take ownership of how well it is managed.

Ready to grow with Screwfix? Register your interest and tell us about your range.

How it works

1

Set up

  • Send consignment stock into the Screwfix network
  • Stock stays yours until it sells
2

We fulfil

  • We store, pick, pack and despatch every order
  • Returns are handled for you
  • Fees are based on product size (m³)
3

Review

  • Fees are invoiced monthly, with 30-day payment terms
  • Track stock, storage and returns
  • Optimise your range to keep costs down

FBS service charges

FBS is a paid-for service with transparent, dimension-based pricing. Fees cover receipt, handling, despatch, storage and returns, and are based on the size of your product (m³). Charges are invoiced on a calendar month cycle with 30-day payment terms.

ChargeRateBasis
Inbound, put away, replen, packaging, despatch£86.81 per m³ handledVolume of product × units processed
Pick fee£0.76 per unit pickedPer unit picked
Courier costs£132.26 per m³ shippedVolume of product × units shipped
Storage cost£22.17 per m³ per monthAverage inventory volume stored monthly
Returns handling£1.73 per returned unitPer returned unit processed

Example: tape measure

Packaged size 11.3 x 8.8 x 4cm

Fulfilment: £0.85

Storage: £0.01

£0.86total per unit

Ways to keep your costs down

Right-size your packaging
Fees scale with m³, so smaller packaged products cost less to store and ship
Manage your stock levels
Storage is charged on average inventory volume, so avoid holding slow movers
Reduce returns
Returns are charged per unit processed, so accurate listings save money

Partner Fulfilled: your stock, connected to the Screwfix network

Partner Fulfilled lets you keep your inventory in your own network and connect it to the reach, stores and customers of Screwfix. Orders are delivered to a Screwfix store for Collect from Screwfix, or direct to the customer’s chosen location.

Why partners choose Partner Fulfilled

  • Unlock store collection: connect your stock to a nationwide network of almost 1,000 stores.
  • Grow efficiently: use your existing inventory and fulfilment capability, without Screwfix having to hold every product.
  • Stay in control: you keep ownership of your stock and take responsibility for content, availability and delivery, within clear Screwfix standards.

Ready to grow with Screwfix? Register your interest and tell us about your range.

How it works

1

Connect

  • Connect to Screwfix via Virtualstock
  • Keep stock levels updated at least 3 times a day
2

Order

  • Customer places an order
  • It is fed through Virtualstock to you
  • Acknowledge within 2 hours
3

Ship

  • Pick, pack and ship with a courier of your choice
  • Delivered complete, on time and damage-free
  • Send dispatch and tracking updates
4

Collect

  • Customer collects from their chosen Screwfix store
  • Next day pre-12pm, or up to 3 working days
5

Return

  • Returns go via the Screwfix store
  • Supports the 30-day money back guarantee

Partner Fulfilled service standards

Partner Fulfilled combines Partner to Store and Partner Direct Delivery in one proposition. You arrange and fund delivery. Under the Partnership Agreement, your vendor value is a retained percentage of the retail selling price, agreed in your Vendor Business Agreement.

StandardTargetApplies to
Acknowledge orders and enquiriesWithin 2 hoursStore and home
Inventory updatesAt least 3 times dailyStore and home
Delivery lead time to storeNext day pre-12pm, or up to 3 working daysPartner to Store
Proof of delivery updateWithin 72 hoursStore and home
Customer returns collectionWithin 5 working daysCarrier collection

Two routes, one proposition

Partner to Store

Your stock connects into the Screwfix store network for customer collection.

Partner Direct Delivery

Your stock is delivered direct to the customer’s chosen location.

Minimum coverage: UK Mainland, Isle of Wight, Northern Ireland and the Highlands.
